verdict.rationale: Grok Build supports MCP servers that expose external tools to the agent alongside its built-in tools. The docs show adding a hosted workflow tool (`grok mcp add --transport http linear https://mcp.linear.app/mcp`), and Grok also reuses existing MCP configs from Claude Code and Cursor, so workflow tools can be connected to extend its context. A plugin Marketplace adds a further extension path. Missing for 10: any evidence of Jira, Slack or Google Drive connectors specifically (only Linear is shown), detail on auth/OAuth for those services, and independent hands-on confirmation of workflow-tool integrations.
